summary: Datto RMM 'Sistema e utente' feature tested end-to-end. Backend GET /api/datto/device-info: 11/11 pytest pass (client+ip, ip_list secondary, mac-only, lowercase/dash mac, mac_list secondary, 400 no params, 400 ip w/o client & mac, found:false unknown/wrong client, 401/403 unauth, switch-ports neighbor match_source=datto_rmm with seeded endpoint). Response has all 13 expected fields and no serial/bios/memory/disks/antivirus/raw_enc/uid/mac_list/ip_list. Frontend: DattoInfoPanel verified collapsed-by-default + toggle in SwitchPortsPage port detail (datto-*-port-3), in Vista Cavo modal (datto-*-cable-3), and open-by-default in DeviceInfoCard Identity (datto-*-card-10.10.1.10) on SRVDATI86B. Values: Windows Server 2019 Datacenter (1809) 64bit, SRVDATI86B\Administrator, WORKGROUP, reboot 14/10/26, reboot required No, Online. Non-Datto device shows 'Dispositivo non presente in Datto RMM.'. No hardware words leaked in UI.

minor.issue: Docstring says 'match MAC, poi IP' but a single find_one with $or [mac, mac_list, ip, ip_list] returns an arbitrary match - if mac and ip both given and the IP is reused by a different Datto device, the wrong device can be returned. Do two queries (MAC first, then IP).

MAC-only lookup (no client_id) is not tenant-scoped; duplicate/virtual MACs exist across clients (e.g. 54:50:49:00:00:31 in 13 devices across 4 clients) -> returns arbitrary device of possibly another client. Frontend always passes clientId so impact is low; consider requiring client_id or returning found:false when MAC is ambiguous across clients.
MAC normalization only uppercases and replaces '-'; a bare MAC '00155D01790D' or Cisco dotted form returns found:false. Reuse existing _norm_mac() helper in the same file.

integration_issues.issue: Each panel open triggers the /api/datto/device-info request twice (likely React StrictMode double effect in dev, d still null). Harmless; could be guarded with an AbortController/ref.

issues: Labels at 8px and values at 10px are very small/hard to read, especially in the narrow DeviceInfoCard Identity column where OS string is truncated ('...64...' - only tooltip shows full)

In DeviceInfoCard the panel is shown (open, with API call) for every device even when not in Datto / client not linked to Datto, showing 'Dispositivo non presente in Datto RMM.' - consider hiding when found:false

action_items: Optional: device-info lookup MAC-first then IP (two queries) to honor documented priority
Optional: use _norm_mac() for mac param; scope/disambiguate mac-only lookups across tenants
Optional: hide DattoInfoPanel in DeviceInfoCard when found:false; increase label font size
